name: 05-document-summary
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT DOCUMENT VIEWER: back top bar 'Normalization.pdf', search and overflow; compact 'Page 12 of 18' with next/previous page controls, rendered white PDF page with heading 'Normalization', readable sample lecture text, a simple Student table with StudentID, Name, DepartmentID columns and 3 example rows, short definition. The document is content, not a cartoon. Bottom compact actions 'Summary', 'Ask', 'Practise' with consistent icons. RIGHT SUMMARY: back 'Lecture 06', bookmark, title 'Normalization, in plain words.', short source 'Normalization.pdf · pp. 12–18'. Three concise stacked sections 1NF Atomic values, 2NF Full-key dependencies, 3NF No transitive dependencies with short explanations and page links. One small blue takeaway panel. Fixed bottom 'Practise this lecture'. No mascot interfering with long text; keep source links clearly interactive. Strong readable typography and content density.
